tools.name: find_gift_ideas
tools.description: Find gift ideas for a specific person and occasion. Searches TrueGift's published gift guides and returns concrete product picks (with the reason each fits) plus the best-matching guides. Examples: recipient="mom", occasion="christmas", max_budget_usd=50; recipient="coworker", occasion="secret-santa

tools.name: list_gift_guides
tools.description: List TrueGift gift guides, optionally filtered by occasion or recipient.

tools.name: get_gift_guide
tools.description: Get one TrueGift gift guide by slug, including its gift picks when available.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "find_gift_ideas" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
